Ship from Wales & South West England to Hatay, Turkey — Hanbros UK Leader in UK–Turkey Cargo

Planning to send cargo, parcels, household goods or commercial freight from Wales & South West England to Hatay? Hanbros UK is the trusted name for United Kingdom to Turkey shipping. We combine scheduled collections across Wales & South West with dedicated road and sea routes to Hatay and all major Turkish cities — delivering faster transit, transparent pricing and full customs support.

Whether you are a Turkish diaspora family in the UK, a business replenishing stock in Hatay, or a student returning home with personal effects, our team manages every mile: professional packing, UK export declaration, CMR-insured transit and door-to-door delivery to your address in Hatay.

Why Hanbros UK for Wales & South West → Hatay Shipments?

  • Regional collection expertise: Regular pick-ups across Wales & South West England — no need to deliver to a distant depot.
  • UK–Turkey corridor leader: Thousands of successful shipments annually on the England–Turkey route.
  • Customs handled: HMRC export and Turkish import clearance prepared by experienced brokers.
  • Flexible services: Groupage parcels, part-load removals, full van loads and express options.
  • Live tracking: WhatsApp and email updates from collection in the UK to delivery in Hatay.
  • Bilingual team: English and Turkish coordinators who understand both countries' requirements.

Route highlight: Collections from Wales & South West are consolidated through our UK hub and dispatched on optimised Hatay-bound schedules — typically 7–14 days door-to-door for groupage, depending on service level and customs.

Services Available on This Route

  • International cargo & parcels — cartons, suitcases and multi-box consignments.
  • Household removals — furniture, appliances and personal effects with professional packing.
  • Vehicle shipping — cars and motorcycles with DVLA export and Turkish registration support.
  • Commercial freight — pallets, shop stock and B2B consignments with commercial invoices.
  • New furniture — direct delivery from UK retailers to Turkish addresses.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I book a collection from Wales & South West?

Complete our online quote form, call our UK office or message us on WhatsApp with your postcode and inventory. We confirm collection date and price within one working day.

What documents are needed for shipping to Hatay?

Typically a packing list, copy of ID/passport, and for personal effects a Transfer of Residence declaration where applicable. Our team guides you through every document.

Is my shipment insured?

Yes. Standard CMR cover applies to international road freight. Enhanced All-Risk insurance is available for high-value or fragile goods.

Can you deliver anywhere in Hatay and surrounding provinces?

Absolutely. We deliver door-to-door in Hatay city centre and districts, and coordinate onward delivery across the province and neighbouring regions.

Hanbros UK — the leading UK to Turkey cargo specialist. From Wales & South West to Hatay, every shipment managed with care.
